title: ParkedRunResult
description:
The structured result of a run that ended PARKED (D115): it reached a step that depends on something outside its control and stopped instead of waiting in place. Fulfils demand `platform-vault-20260930-contracts-d115-parked-work`.

A parked run has RELEASED its runner slot and repository lock; it keeps its `reference.branch` and `checkpoint`. The wait belongs to the run; the demand stays the statement of intent, and its board entry reads 'waiting on <condition>' from `wait.condition`. `demand-coordinator` routes and approves only and does not resume anything.

**Every wait has a deadline.** `wait.deadline` is required and must be after `parkedAt`; an expired wait is surfaced to the owner through the owner UI, never left to stall silently. (Not expressible in JSON Schema; consumers enforce it.)

**Who resumes.** `resumeOwner` is `factory` for a Factory delivery and `agent-runner` for a plain demand dispatch. Only that owner resumes the run, by ONE keyed dispatch per wake event (`parked.resume-request`).

**Exact reference.** `reference` names the concrete things the wait is about (repo, branch, pull request, commit, demand ids) so a producer event can be matched without parsing `resumeNote`. `resumeNote` is what the resumed agent is told about where it stopped and what it was waiting for; it is carried into the resume dispatch prompt together with the observed outcome.

dispatchKey.description: The dispatch key the parked run was started under, when it was keyed.

demandId.description: The demand being worked, when the run was dispatched for one.

waitId.description: Stable id of this wait, minted once when the run parks. Together with an event's `eventKey` it determines the resume dispatch key.

deadline.description: When the wait expires and is surfaced to the owner. Required.

reference.description: The exact things the wait concerns. Only the members that apply are present.

checkpoint.description: Full commit SHA of the run's last checkpoint on `reference.branch`; `null` or absent when nothing was checkpointed.
